program:
alphabet a b c d

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
is_d = symbol d
h1_1 = rightmost(is_a@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j & !is_d@j, !is_b@j | is_a@j & !is_c@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j & !is_d@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i & !is_d@i, true)
accept = h2_1 | h1_1 & h2_1

output accept
